HISD Theme Toggle

Icon-only day/night theme control for app headers. The active state uses aria-pressed and each button has an explicit accessible name. Use the appbar variant when the active dark option should be a light pill with an icon color supplied by the app bar.

Light surface

Dark surface

App bar variant

Markup

<div class="hisd-theme-toggle hisd-theme-toggle--appbar" role="group" aria-label="Theme">
  <button class="hisd-theme-toggle__button" data-theme-option="light" data-active="true"
          aria-pressed="true" aria-label="Use light theme">...</button>
  <button class="hisd-theme-toggle__button" data-theme-option="dark" data-active="false"
          aria-pressed="false" aria-label="Use dark theme">...</button>
</div>
